name: drush-pre-deploy
description: drush integration that enables pre-deploy hooks.
project_description: drush integration that enables "pre-deploy" hooks. Drush 10 introduced the `drush deploy` command to standardize Drupal deployment, implemented as a fixed sequence: `updatedb --no-cache-clear`, `cache:rebuild`, `config:import`, `cache:rebuild`, `deploy:hook`. The last step invokes `hook_deploy_NAME()` functions, which run at the very end of a deploy. This project introduces the symmetric concept of "pre-deploy" hooks that run at the very beginning of the deploy process, before database updates and config import. A pre-deploy hook is a function named `MODULE_predeploy_NAME(array &$sandbox): ?string` placed in a `MODULE.predeploy.php` file, mirroring the shape of core deploy hooks. The module adds two Drush commands: `deploy:pre-hook` runs pending pre-deploy hooks (with a confirmation prompt) and `deploy:pre-hook-status` prints information about pending pre-deploy hooks. It reuses core's UpdateRegistry with an updateType of `predeploy` and a keyvalue store (`pre_deploy_hook`) so each hook runs only once per environment. An optional "global" Drush command file (registered via a project `drush.yml` include) hooks `pre-command deploy` so that `deploy:pre-hook` is dispatched automatically at the start of every `drush deploy`. The module has no dependencies, no permissions, no configuration UI and no web routes; it is a developer/CLI deployment tool.
